original_title: Jared Kushner's Saudi-Funded Affinity Partners: $157M in Fees, Zero Returns

existing.title: Jared Kushner's Saudi-Funded Affinity Partners: $157M in Fees, Zero Returns
existing.description_short: Jared Kushner's Saudi-Funded Affinity Partners: $157M in Fees, Zero Returns
existing.description_medium: A Senate Finance Committee investigation found that Kushner's Affinity Partners collected $157 million in management fees from foreign governments — including $87 million directly from Saudi Arabia's PIF — while returning zero profits to clients as of July 2024. PIF's own investment board recommended against the Affinity deal due to Kushner's 'inexperience,' but Crown Prince MBS overruled them. By March 2026, Kushner was soliciting $5 billion more for Fund II from Saudi PIF while simultaneously serving as Trump's informal Middle East adviser on issues directly affecting Saudi interests.

original_title: Trump Signs Order Gutting Public Education, Targeting DEI

existing.title: Trump Signs Order Gutting Public Education, Targeting DEI
existing.description_short: Trump Signs Order Gutting Public Education, Targeting DEI
existing.description_medium: In March 2025, Trump signed an executive order directing the Department of Education to end federal support for DEI programs in public schools and universities, threatening withdrawal of federal funding. School districts faced demands to eliminate curricula deemed anti-American under threat of losing grants. University administrators faced demands to certify compliance under threat of losing research funding. The American Association of Universities and major research institutions condemned the orders. Legal challenges mounted with courts issuing preliminary injunctions, but the chilling effect on academic freedom was immediate and widespread.
